implementedGuards: Preserve macro/control/signature/embedded-resource bytes and bindings for ordinary cell edits.
Refuse sheet management and row/column or merge changes when macro/control bindings cannot be rewritten safely.
Refuse changes to OPC-signed document parts rather than retaining an invalidated document signature.
Permit no-op signed-package copying with no touched entries.
Protect direct assembler plans from deleting macro/control payloads, their relationships or macro-enabled content types.
Distinguish proven note-only VML from controls, allowing normal note addition/update/removal without weakening mixed/unknown/control preservation.
Shared planner guards cover native sidecar and in-memory saves; no changes to xlsx-package-io.ts.

sourceInspection.xlsm: Sheets interactive Save As already retains .xlsm and macro-enabled content types; native archive saves copy untouched parts. New tests and guards strengthen this preserve-only path.
sourceInspection.docm: No dedicated .docm editing/save acceptance found. The DOCX engine recognizes .docm only in embedded altChunk classification; desktop open/save filters target .docx.
sourceInspection.pptm: No dedicated .pptm editing/save acceptance found; desktop launcher/save paths target .pptx. PPTX cleanup can collect removed slide-owned ActiveX/control resources, so XLSM results do not certify PPTM behavior.

limits: Fixtures contain inert synthetic binary/signature sentinels, not actual executable or cryptographically valid VBA/ActiveX/OLE projects.
